---
title: "The biomedical applications of multi-elemental imaging with LIBS"
date: 2018-07-18
description: "Review of LIBS elemental imaging for biological and medical applications."
categories: [Publication, LIBS, Elemental Imaging, Review]
---

This review discussed the emerging biomedical applications of **multi-elemental LIBS imaging**, including the visualization of endogenous and exogenous elements in biological tissues.

Published in *Coordination Chemistry Reviews* (2018). DOI: [10.1016/j.ccr.2017.12.006](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ccr.2017.12.006).
